findings.claim: Legacy-layout complex obs still cost 3 existence checks and 6 filesystem operations per read, the same as master, so TRUNK-6682's first acceptance criterion ('at most one existence-related check') holds only for new-layout keys. The PR description's unqualified claim that a read 'now costs 3 filesystem operations' is wrong for those obs. The open thread asking whether the ticket stays open for the layout-resolution half (r4070873940) still has no answer.
findings.failure_mode: If merged as-is, TRUNK-6682 closes with its acceptance criterion unmet for every legacy-layout obs, which on an upgraded install means every complex obs saved before 2.8. Nothing would track the remaining parseDataKey/exists probes (2 Files.exists that miss on the raw filename) plus the failed stat and legacy Files.exists in LocalStorageService.read, and the inaccurate per-read cost in the description becomes the record. No test pins the legacy-layout count either, so it can regress silently.
findings.evidence: Throwaway test (deleted) drove the real AbstractHandler.getObs, TextHandler.getObs(TEXT_VIEW) and BinaryDataHandler.getObs(RAW_VIEW) through the autowired LocalStorageService, counting every java.nio.file.Files call with Mockito.mockStatic(Files.class, CALLS_REAL_METHODS). Controls: Files.exists alone gave {exists=1}, an empty runnable gave {}, and Files.newInputStream gave {newInputStream=1, newByteChannel=2 (internal)}. HEAD 86b96c7d6: new layout {exists=1, readAttributes=1, newInputStream=1}; legacy layout (file at appdata/obs/<uuid>.txt, valueComplex 'legacy.txt|<uuid>.txt') {exists=3, readAttributes=2 (one fails on the current location), newInputStream=1}. master a93b6293c (api/src/main+test checked out from master, then restored): both layouts {exists=4, readAttributes=1, newInputStream=1}. So new layout goes from 6 to 3 ops and legacy stays at 6 to 6. Paths: AbstractHandler.parseDataKey (unchanged) -> LocalStorageService.exists:278-294 -> LocalStorageService.read:96-119. PR body: 'it now costs 3 filesystem operations on local storage'. Ticket AC1 in trunk-6682-at-review.json.

findings.claim: TRUNK-6682 carries the `backport` label and the StorageService API it extends is tagged '@since 2.8.0, 2.7.5, 2.6.16, 2.5.15'. The new DataWithMetadata, StorageService.getDataWithMetadata and the 3-arg injectMissingMetadata are tagged '@since 3.0.0' only, so is this master-only, with the label to be dropped, or does it get backported, in which case each @since needs the maintenance versions and the Java 16+ constructs it adds (`private record LoadedImage` in ImageHandler, pattern-matching `instanceof S3Exception s3Exception` in S3StorageService) need checking against those lines' compiler level?
findings.evidence: grep '@since' api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/StorageService.java and api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/storage/*.java: StorageService, ObjectMetadata and LocalStorageService are '2.8.0, 2.7.5, 2.6.16, 2.5.15', while DataWithMetadata.java:21 and StorageService.java:197 are '3.0.0'. Ticket labels: backport, community-priority, performance. Prior thread r4070873955 asked for 'the version this actually lands in, plus whatever maintenance lines it gets backported to'. master pom has maven.compiler.release 21, and the clone has no maintenance branches or tags, so I could not check their Java level.

verdict: Not ready yet. The new-layout read path really does drop from 6 to 3 filesystem operations and every earlier review thread is addressed at head, but legacy-layout obs still cost the same 6 operations as master. Whether TRUNK-6682 closes on this PR or stays open for that half (the open r4070873940 question) has to be settled, and the description corrected, before merge.
